subject: [PATCH v4 1/8] mm/page_alloc: reset can_retry_reserves when the slowpath restarts

reviews.author: Vlastimil Babka (SUSE)
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the wording in the commit log, suggesting that it might not accurately reflect the changes made by the patch. Also questioned the behavior of can_retry_reserves after a restart and its implications for reclaim and no-reclaim/PF_MEMALLOC callers.

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Addressed Vlastimil's concerns about the commit log and clarified the behavior of can_retry_reserves after a restart. Provided additional context on how the patch resolves an issue with concurrent zone list rebuilds.

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the handling of reserve allocations in the slowpath of the page allocator. The first patch specifically addresses an issue where the can_retry_reserves flag is not reset after a restart, leading to failed allocations for certain callers. The fix involves resetting this flag at restart, ensuring that reclaim and no-reclaim/PF_MEMALLOC callers receive retry attempts when necessary.
